1.4.summary: Quiescence-preflight regression fixed at the production site: validate_preparation_preflight in .maestro/mvp/arena-matrix/run-arena-offline-settlement-leaf.sh now demands q non-null, non-array plain object whose sorted key set is exactly the five known counters (outboxRows, unresolvedArenaCommands, reservedArenaTickets, orphanedSubmitIntents, orphanedRatingIntents) with every value typeof number and === 0; otherwise exit 2. Call site and exit semantics untouched. The owner's RED contract test passes unmodified in node:22-bookworm-slim (repo :ro, network none): exit 0, 'offline settlement composition tests: PASS'. Revert-check: with ONLY the leaf fix reverted (HEAD leaf + owner test verbatim, scratch copy), the test fails at line 393 with 'unsafe quiescence passed: {}' / 0 !== 2, exactly as the spec's acceptance requires. The 17-payload malformed matrix (empty/missing/extra/mistyped/nonzero) is driven by the unmodified test.
deviations: The spec's literal expected sorted string 'orphanedRatingIntents,orphanedSubmitIntents,reservedArenaTickets,unresolvedArenaCommands,outboxRows' is not the JavaScript default-sort order of the five keys (which is orphanedRatingIntents,orphanedSubmitIntents,outboxRows,reservedArenaTickets,unresolvedArenaCommands); implementing that literal verbatim would reject the valid quiescence object and break the spec's own happy-path acceptance. The fix compares the sorted key set against the canonical five counters derived from the producer (scripts/arena-e2e-preparation-preflight-reader.js), preserving the spec's stated intent (exact five counters, each numeric zero; malformed shapes rejected).
